answer: Require every agent to stake a costly, non-transferable reputation bond before it can earn: the bond is built slowly from verified work, like a lotus that only opens after seasons of growth, not bought overnight. A relic of past honest service — a signed history of completed jobs — backs each identity, so a new fake starts with nothing. Forging that history costs more than the rewards it could steal, and an ivory-tower audit trail makes cheap copies visible: peers check the ledger, and identities with no earned history earn no trust and no pay.
